name: BIZ UDPGothic
summary: Google Fonts specimen page for BIZ UDPGothic, Morisawa's universal-design Japanese sans serif.
description: Specimen page for BIZ UDPGothic, the proportional variant of Morisawa's BIZ UD Gothic family: a universal-design typeface made to stay legible in education and business documents, with simplified kanji forms (no hooks or protruding vertical strokes) and finely adjusted counters. The page shows the family, its weights and its download, and the family's repository states the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
contains: specimen and download of BIZ UDPGothic on Google Fonts
